status.invalid: The data package on the system failed verification (signature, expiry or format), so it isn't used. Please tell an administrator.
status.unavailable: Couldn't load signed data from the server. You can still enter values yourself.

freshness.label: Data source and freshness
freshness.stale: May be out of date — last checked on {{date}}, more than {{days}} days ago. Compare with the official source before relying on it.
freshness.unchecked: This source has no check date. Compare with the official source before relying on it.
freshness.expired: The source document is no longer in effect. The figures may no longer apply.
freshness.superseded: The source document has been replaced by a newer one. The figures may no longer apply.
freshness.revoked: This source has been withdrawn. Do not rely on these figures for decisions.
freshness.registryUnavailable: Could not load the source record; showing the details carried in the signed data package.
freshness.reference: The default figures are reference conventions with no checked official source and no check date. Replace them with your own.
